suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as acute cardiac complication. Require documented acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) and separately documented ventricular arrhythmia, such as clinically established ventricular tachycardia or ventricular fibrillation, arising in the relevant acute/post-infarction period. PMID 34953752 specifically evaluates early and late ventricular arrhythmias complicating STEMI; do not use it to verify atrial fibrillation, nonspecific ectopy, bradyarrhythmias, every myocardial-infarction subtype, or an arrhythmia arising only remotely from the infarction. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-2 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented acute myocardial infarction and separately documented new or materially worsened heart failure developing in the clinically relevant post-infarction period, with appropriate evidence of ventricular dysfunction and/or a clinically established heart-failure syndrome. Do not infer heart failure from myocardial infarction alone, and do not attribute pre-existing heart failure to a later infarction without evidence of material post-infarction worsening. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
